### Summary of Changes

#### Problem
When deleting a single authentication method ([`AuthInfo`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/apps/iam/pkg/apis/iam/v0alpha1/types.go)) for a user, storage configurations routing through the legacy storage path (DualWriter modes 0, 1, 3) rejected the delete request with a `405 Method Not Supported` status error. The underlying [`LegacyStore.Delete`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store.go#L326) implementation returned `apierrors.NewMethodNotSupported(...)` instead of deleting the entry from the legacy `user_auth` table.

#### Solution
1. **Added single-item deletion to the login AuthInfo store and service interfaces**:
   - Expanded [`login.DeleteAuthInfoCommand`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/model.go#L93-L97) to include `UserId int64` and `AuthModule string` alongside `UserAuth *UserAuth`.
   - Added `DeleteAuthInfo(ctx context.Context, cmd *DeleteAuthInfoCommand) error` to [`login.Store`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfo.go#L20-L28) and [`login.AuthInfoService`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfo.go#L9-L17).

2. **Implemented `DeleteAuthInfo` in backend stores**:
   - **SQL store** ([`pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/store.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/store.go#L358-L399)): Added SQL template [`delete_single_user_auth.sql`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/queries/delete_single_user_auth.sql) executing `DELETE FROM user_auth WHERE user_id = ? AND auth_module = ?` inside the database session, removing only the specific auth row. Added template snapshots for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite in `testdata`.
   - **Service wrapper** ([`pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/service.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/service.go#L195-L217)): Calls the underlying store and invalidates any cached entries for that user and auth module via `deleteUserAuthInfoInCache`.
   - **K8s-backed store** ([`pkg/services/login/authinfok8s/authinfo.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfok8s/authinfo.go#L278-L320)): Deletes the single resource `<userUID>.<authModule>` using the k8s resource client.
   - **Test mocks & fakes** ([`auth_info_store_mock.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfotest/auth_info_store_mock.go), [`auth_info_service_mock.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfotest/auth_info_service_mock.go), [`fake.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfotest/fake.go)): Added mock and fake support for `DeleteAuthInfo`.

3. **Wired up single-item delete in `LegacyStore`**:
   - In [`pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store.go#L326-L365), implemented `Delete(ctx context.Context, name string, deleteValidation rest.ValidateObjectFunc, options *metav1.DeleteOptions) (runtime.Object, bool, error)`:
     - Resolves the name to `(userID, userUID, authModule)`.
     - Verifies object existence via `authInfoStore.GetAuthInfo` (returning 404 if not found).
     - Runs `deleteValidation` if provided.
     - Calls `authInfoStore.DeleteAuthInfo` to remove only that `(userID, authModule)` row from `user_auth`.
     - Returns `(&obj, true, nil)` conforming to `rest.GracefulDeleter`.
   - Kept [`DeleteCollection`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store.go#L367) returning `405 Method Not Supported` since bulk collection deletion remains unsupported.

4. **Updated and Added Tests**:
   - [`pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store_test.go#L278-L345): Added `TestLegacyStore_Delete` covering success, non-existent user (404), non-existent module (404), and malformed names (404), plus `TestLegacyStore_DeleteCollection` verifying 405.
   - [`pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/store_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/store_test.go#L230-L237): Added `DeleteAuthInfo` expectation in `TestProvideStore` and snapshot testing for `deleteSingleUserAuthTemplate`.
   - [`pkg/services/login/authinfok8s/authinfo_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/services/login/authinfok8s/authinfo_test.go#L661-L683): Added `TestStore_DeleteAuthInfo` verifying the single-resource delete request to k8s.
   - [`pkg/tests/apis/iam/authinfo/authinfo_integration_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v3/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v3-1/pkg/tests/apis/iam/authinfo/authinfo_integration_test.go#L212-L253): Updated `doAuthInfoDeleteTests` across DualWriter modes (0, 1, 3) to create two auth methods for a user, delete one, assert success, verify the deleted method returns 404, verify the other method remains intact, and verify `DeleteCollection` continues to return 405.
